title: Show job planning in athena status; fix recovery of jobs killed in
summary: Job 5a of the job-planning design. Planned jobs get a plan state and round in the status line, first-round accept and stop counts in the summary, per-round verdicts and findings in `status <job>`, and plans and critiques in `--json`. `recover_interrupted` stops adding a "missing producer" invocation when the job died in planning. The audience is a maintainer running `athena status` and `athena close`.

defaults_applied.how: New unit and integration tests; clippy and fmt criteria.
Criteria check rendered output and recorded invocations.
Only status, display and manage changes.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Planner and Critic roles and plan/critique records already exist from jobs 1 to 4; this job only reads them.
Recovery fix: skip the missing-producer record when any Planner or Critic invocation exists and no producer ran (a job that died while planning).
Unplanned output stays byte-identical because new fields are skipped when empty.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test`. A test shows a planned job's status line contains "plan accepted r<n>" or "plan stopped r<n>" with the correct round, and the summary shows first-round accept and stop counts.
Run `cargo test`. A test compares an unplanned job's status output with its pre-change text and finds it byte-identical, with no new lines or columns.
Run `cargo test`. A test shows `athena status <job>` for a planned job lists each round with its verdict and findings.

Run `cargo test`. A test shows `status <job> --json` for a multi-round planned job includes every round's plan and critique, with verdicts and findings, and that an unplanned job's JSON gains no new keys.

Run `cargo test`. A test closes a job whose process died during planning (planner or critic records or usage partials exist, no producer). The planning invocations are recorded and no Missing producer invocation is added. A job with no trace of any invocation still gets the existing missing-producer behavior.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and xtask's boundary test (`cargo test -p xtask`). All pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing planning in status and the recovery fix.
athena.toml is unchanged and planning is not turned on.

departures: Touches three modules plus JSON and tests, so I expect somewhat higher cost than the reference.
